title: 421. Palindrome Pairs

examples.explanation: Reversed partners plus the s/lls/sssll interactions give four pairs.
Only bat and tab complete each other into palindromes.
The empty string pairs with any single palindrome word in both directions.

hints: Index every word so reversed candidates can be looked up instantly.
Split each word at every cut: when one side is a palindrome, the mirror of the other side is the needed partner.
Treat the empty string and whole-word mirrors as special cases of the same split rule.
